dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave parabolic spline from the posterior insertion point to the apex.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Posteriorly inclined at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 150 degrees at the junction of the melon and the dorsal plane of the rostrum.
